description:
At 2026-06-15T12:34:56Z (UTC) the App Service log entry for the resource /subscriptions/12345678-90ab-cdef-1234-567890abcdef/resourceGroups/example-rg/providers/Microsoft.Web/sites/example-app recorded an **Microsoft.Web/sites/read** operation (version 2021-02-01) under the **AppService** category. The request originated from IP 203.0.113.45, was processed in the **East US** region, and was logged at the **Information** level.

The operation completed with a **Success** status, signature OK, and the description “Operation completed successfully.” It took 247 ms to finish. The log entry is linked by correlation ID a1b2c3d4-e5f6-7890-abcd-ef1234567890, and the identity that performed the action carried the claims role:reader and tenantId:12345678-90ab-cdef-1234-567890abcdef.
